_comment: Vendor- and model-independent scoring. Order: hard filters -> quality floor (evidence) -> cost -> tie-breakers. Cost never outranks the quality floor.
floorUnmet: best-evidenced candidate with confidence=low; no evidenced candidate at all -> inherit
riskFromTaskText: loop_tier plan_keywords with tier L (auth, secrets, crypto, PII, SQL, ERP, payment, interop, public contract) -> risk=high

cost.metric: observed AI credits per call on this host (assistant usage records)
cost.unknown: ranked after known-cost candidates of the same evidence level (never assumed cheaper)

familyTransfer: owner decision 2026-10-12: a model with no evidence of its own inherits the best POSITIVE evidence of an OLDER version of the same family (id without its numeric tokens, e.g. vendor-pro-5 -> vendor-pro-5.5), confidence low; within a family the newer version is ranked before an older one it matches by evidence, even with unknown cost. Failures never transfer; own evidence (pass or fail) always overrides the transfer.
